rawAnswer: {"story":{"what":"TypeCollector now sends every analyzer diagnostic through a filter that reports it only when its location is in source and in a syntax tree of the compilation being analyzed. Two places that used to index DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] directly now use safe lookups: the BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull property diagnostic and the field MemberNeedsKey diagnostic. Properties and fields that come from metadata therefore no longer throw. New generator tests compile a defining assembly to a metadata-only image, reference it from a [MessagePackObject] consumer, run the analyzers and the generator, and check that the resolver source is produced. The change also adds README and MsgPack004 docs, plus an unrelated edit to MessagePackSecurity.GetEqualityComparer for string keys.","why":"When a member type was a closed generic struct or record struct from a referenced assembly, the collector walked that type's members.
